name: What is the typical cost of a bathroom remodel in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost of a bathroom remodel in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a bathroom remodel in Orange County varies significantly based on factors like size, desired finishes, and structural changes. A minor renovation might range from $15,000 to $25,000, focusing on cosmetic updates like new paint, fixtures, and possibly a vanity. A mid-range remodel, which could include replacing the tub, toilet, and vanity, and some tile work, typically falls between $30,000 and $50,000. High-end remodels involving custom cabinetry, luxury materials, and reconfiguring the layout can exceed $70,000. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom remodel costs in Orange County vary widely, from $15,000 for minor updates to over $70,000 for luxury renovations, depending on scope and materials.
